title: surge_basics.t1 omitted from chunk-5-goldens.patch — the surge demo's T1 determinism manifest went unreviewed by every lens
location: chunk-5-goldens.patch (missing; present in PR at diff.patch:18034)
evidence: chunk-5-goldens.patch lists goldens/surge_basics.log.bin (line 1011) and goldens/surge_basics/*.png (lines 1015-1035) but no goldens/surge_basics.t1; grep 'surge_basics.t1' across chunk-1..chunk-6 patches returns zero matches; diff.patch:18034 shows 'diff --git a/goldens/surge_basics.t1 b/goldens/surge_basics.t1' (3007 lines; header 'ticks 3000'; worktree has it at the reviewed sha)
detail: The chunking split dropped the one .t1 manifest for the surge demo (the fun-test WIN scenario). Its 3000 per-tick hashes were never lens-verified this round, so surge determinism evidence lacks review.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the chunk set to include goldens/surge_basics.t1 (or run the architecture lens on diff.patch:18034-21041) so the surge T1 manifest is verified before consolidation.
